newsitem.title: ESTONIA: LOCAL INVESTORS MAKE 61 PCT OF BOURSE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: LOCAL INVESTORS MAKE 61 PCT OF BOURSE TRADE.

text.p: Estonian investors accounted for 61.32 percent of investments made into shares traded on the Tallinn bourse at the end of June, the stock exchange said.
The local investors' stake has risen from 59.61 percent at the end of March.
Finnish investors took 10.28 percent, British 8.14 percent and Swedish investors 6.21 percent of investments into shares on the Tallinn bourse, the stock exchange added.
The stake of Latvian investors was 0.2 percent and that of Lithuanians slightly above zero.
